query: 'SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    dp.paciente_key,
    ddep.departamento_key,
    dd.diagnostico_key,
    CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), a.admission_date, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_ingreso_key,
    CASE
        WHEN a.discharge_date IS NOT NULL
            THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), a.discharge_date, 112) AS INT)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fecha_alta_key,
    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
    CASE
        WHEN a.discharge_date IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS dias_estancia,
    CAST(1 AS INT) AS conteo_admisiones
FROM silver.admissions a
INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp
    ON dp.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento ddep
    ON ddep.nombre_departamento = a.department
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        admission_id,
        icd_code,
        severity
    FROM (
        SELECT
            admission_id,
            icd_code,
            severity,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY admission_id ORDER BY diagnosis_id) AS rn
        FROM silver.diagnoses
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
) AS diag
    ON diag.admission_id = a.admission_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dd
    ON dd.codigo_icd = ISNULL(diag.icd_code, 'N/A')
    AND dd.nivel_severidad = ISNULL(diag.severity, 'Unknown')',
